name: Coder Agents
description: A self-hosted, model-agnostic AI coding agent that runs in the control plane. Supports multiple AI providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and self-hosted models with chat interface and API for delegating development work.
community_quotes: Self-hosted AI model-agnostic Coder Agents sets a new standard for AI coding
Beta launched with full feature access and no usage-based limits through September 2026
Runs in the control plane rather than inside the workspace

name: 49Agents
description: Open-source 2D infinite canvas IDE for managing AI agents in native CLIs, terminals, git, and files across multiple projects and machines. Features Claude Code awareness, real terminal panes via tmux, and supports self-hosting.
community_quotes: The first infinite canvas IDE designed specifically for AI
Your terminals on an infinite canvas. Pan, zoom, and arrange real terminal panes in a browser
Claude Code awareness — detects running Claude sessions, shows working/idle/permission state
